task.title: Classify and resolve the untracked dist-swagger root artifact

problem.statement: An untracked top-level directory dist-swagger/ exists at the repository root. repository-structure-gate emits a non-fatal UNAPPROVED_TOP_LEVEL warning for it, and it is not declared anywhere in the cleanup retention policy.

evidence.note: Emits UNAPPROVED_TOP_LEVEL warning for undeclared top-level directories.
Does not currently declare dist-swagger as a generated output root.

rootCauseHypothesis: CORRECTED at iteration 2: tools/scripts/build-swagger-static.mjs (invoked by the swagger:build script) legitimately generates dist-swagger/. The warning source, tools/guards/repository-structure-gate.mjs, maintains its own hard-coded APPROVED_TOP_LEVEL set independent of governance/cleanup/repository-retention-policy.json; adding dist-swagger to the retention policy's generatedOutputRoots (the iteration-1 hypothesis) would not silence this specific warning. The real fix adds "dist-swagger" to that hard-coded set.

current: dist-swagger/ is untracked, undeclared, and produces a structure-gate warning.
required: dist-swagger/ is either declared as a generated output root (if it is genuinely a build artifact) or removed locally with no tracked change introducing it.
forbidden: Tracking dist-swagger/ or any of its contents in git.

acceptance.statement: repository-structure-gate no longer emits UNAPPROVED_TOP_LEVEL for dist-swagger/.
